title: FloodGuard Mitigation Credit for Loss-Avoidance Reimbursements
content:
Claims and rating note — FloodGuard Private Flood Policy.

A policyholder whose sandbagging, fill or pumping was reimbursed as loss avoidance earns a mitigation credit on the additional premium for a limit increase. A mitigation credit reduces the additional premium by 5 percent when a loss-avoidance reimbursement was paid on the policy within the 24 months before the date the charge is posted and no building or contents payment was issued in that window; by 2 percent when a loss-avoidance reimbursement was paid in that window and a building or contents payment was also issued in it; and by nothing when no loss-avoidance reimbursement was paid in that window.

**Records read.** The flood claim payments issued on the policy within the 24 months before the date the additional premium is posted, sorted by coverage part: loss-avoidance reimbursements on one side, building and contents payments on the other.

Input – judgement – output:

| Loss-avoidance reimbursement paid in the 24 months | Building or contents payment issued in the 24 months | Mitigation credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | 5 percent |
| yes | yes | 2 percent |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | none |

**Hypothetical cases** (charge posted 2025-09-01; the window opens 24 months earlier, on 2023-09-01):

- A loss-avoidance reimbursement paid on 2024-04-12 and no building or contents payment since 2023-09-01: 5 percent.
- The same reimbursement, plus a contents payment issued on 2024-05-03: 2 percent.
- A building payment issued on 2024-05-03 and no loss-avoidance reimbursement in the window: none.
- A loss-avoidance reimbursement paid on 2023-06-30, outside the window, and nothing since: none.
